app.name: SmritiSetu
app.tagline: Cognitive Memory Bridge for Elderly Care
app.disclaimer.banner: Assistive cognitive-support only. Not a medical diagnosis.
app.disclaimer.full: SmritiSetu is a cognitive-support and monitoring prototype. It does not diagnose dementia, replace a physician, or prescribe medical treatments.
welcome.subtitle: Your friendly daily companion for memory exercises and health reminders.
welcome.audio_prompt: Welcome to SmritiSetu. Tap the big blue button to begin, or tap change language above.
login.title: Simple Sign In
login.subtitle: Enter your phone number or tap Quick Access below.
login.audio_help: Please enter your 10 digit phone number to sign in, or tap Quick Access for demo mode.
login.error_empty_phone: Please enter your phone number or tap Quick Access
login.error_failed: Sign in failed. Please try again.
elderly_home.title: SmritiSetu Home
elderly_home.date_summary: Today is a beautiful day to exercise your memory.
elderly_home.card_meds_sub: Check your schedule and mark taken
elderly_home.card_call_caregiver_sub: Reach your family member with one tap
elderly_home.audio_prompt: This is your home screen. Tap Brain Games to play, or My Medicines to check your pills.
games.title: Brain Games
games.subtitle: Gentle exercises to keep your mind active and happy.
games.audio_prompt: Here are four fun games designed for you. Tap on any card to read how to play.
game.face_match.title: Family Face Match
game.face_match.instruction: Look at the photo and tap the matching family member.
game.face_match.desc: Recognize loved ones and recall their special relationships.
game.pattern.title: Pattern Completion
game.pattern.instruction: Which symbol comes next to complete the pattern?
game.pattern.desc: Identify traditional motifs and finish the repeating rhythm.
game.sequence.title: Daily Activity Sequence
game.sequence.instruction: Arrange these everyday steps in the correct order.
game.sequence.desc: Order morning tea preparation and everyday daily steps.
game.sorting.title: Object Sorting
game.sorting.instruction: Tap each object into its matching group.
game.sorting.desc: Sort seasonal fruits, flowers, and household items.
game.sorting.drag_or_tap: Which group does this belong to?
instructions.title: How to Play
instructions.step1: Step 1: Look closely at the picture shown on screen.
instructions.step2: Step 2: Take your time. There is no rush or time pressure.
instructions.step3: Step 3: Tap the option that feels right to you.
instructions.audio_prompt: Listen to the instructions: Take your time, observe the images, and tap the answer you choose. Tap Start Game when you are ready.
results.title: Game Completed
results.disclaimer: Non-clinical game metrics for personal cognitive stimulation.
results.audio_prompt: Great job! You have successfully finished your brain exercise today.
medication.title: My Medicines
medication.schedule_subtitle: Tap any medicine to view instructions or mark as taken.
medication.audio_prompt: Here is your medicine list for today. Tap on any medicine to confirm you took it.
reminder.take_prompt: It is time for your afternoon medicine.
reminder.instructions_label: Take 1 tablet after food with a warm glass of water.
reminder.audio_alert: Attention: It is time to take your prescribed medicine. Please take one tablet after food with water.
reminder.snack_taken: Medicine recorded as taken. Great job!
history.title: My Activity Progress
history.subtitle: Celebrate your daily brain workouts and healthy habits.
history.encouragement: Consistency is key to keeping your mind sharp and active!
history.audio_prompt: You are doing great! You have a five day streak of daily activities.
settings.title: Accessibility Settings
settings.high_contrast_sub: Deep black background with vivid gold highlights
settings.voice_sub: Speech speed, volume, and voice test
settings.audio_prompt: You can customize text size, contrast, and voice settings here.
language.title: Select Language
language.audio_prompt: Choose your preferred language. You can change this at any time.
voice.title: Voice & Audio Settings
voice.subtitle: Calibrate spoken prompts for clear auditory understanding.
voice.test_phrase: Namaste! This is SmritiSetu speaking in your selected voice settings.
caregiver.dashboard.title: Caregiver Monitoring Dashboard
